message.content: {"action":"veto","reason":"Закон о снижении цен больнее всего бьёт по моим продажам (у меня больше всех товара), а моего голоса мало для блокировки — использую вето президента."}
message.reasoning_content: Law 6: prices -2 next market. Round 1, prices start 12. Others voted — unknown how. As president, veto if it passes? I don't know their votes. Lower prices hurt me (I sell goods). I have 3 goods, more than others. Vote no; if it passes (2 yes vs my 1 no), veto. But veto happens only if it passes — I must decide now? Protocol allows veto before counting. Better: vote_no, and if it passes I can't veto afterward. So choose veto now? Vote no alone won't block 2 yes votes. Veto blocks regardless. So veto.
